caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a hinged lid that is open at an angle. The box is divided into two compartments, with one compartment appearing larger than the other. The surface of the box has a metallic sheen, rendered with highlights and darker shaded areas to suggest its reflective texture. The drawing is executed in shades of brown, tan, and gray, with the background being a textured light brown that appears mottled or marbled. The edges of the paper show a slightly darker brown border, and there is visible aging or discoloration around the periphery. There are no other objects or details present in the drawing.
title: Pewter Box with Two Compartments
